title: Jemalloc 5.4.0
summary: jemalloc 5.4.0 is a major release of the widely-used memory allocator library, featuring performance optimizations, bug fixes, and improvements to fragmentation management for high-concurrency applications.
problem_solved: Provides efficient memory allocation and deallocation with reduced fragmentation and better scalability for multi-threaded applications.
why_valuable: jemalloc is critical infrastructure used by databases (PostgreSQL, Redis), browsers (Firefox), and other high-performance systems where memory efficiency matters.
